brief.headline: Cut Dextrose price by 13.6% to match Sayaji — we're paying ₹14.26 L/yr extra for the same material

priceAsk.summary: Drop Dextrose Anhydrous IP from ₹75.51/KG to ₹66.48/KG
priceAsk.basis: We already buy identical Dextrose from Sayaji Industries at ₹66.48/KG. The market asking price band of ₹60–81/kg puts your current ₹75.51/KG at the top end. Match our best price or we move volume to Sayaji and qualify Tirupati or Gulshan as a second line.

paymentTermAsk.summary: No change — keep 30 Days After Receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how much our ₹59.65 L spend matters to them. That means we build our case on hard price facts: Sayaji sells us the same thing 13.6% cheaper, and the market asking price shows ₹75.51/KG sits at the expensive end. With no visibility into their books, we rely on competitive pressure — line up Tirupati, Gulshan or Sanstar as drop-in backups so Universal knows the business will walk if the price doesn't move.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller that makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS in IV-fluid grade — exact form match; a lead to qualify (verify IP monograph CoA before switching)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, established dextrose supplier — a drop-in alternate to Sayaji; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist with growing dextrose capacity; a lead to qualify (verify before RFQ)

risks: Universal's financials aren't public, so we can't tell if a hard price push might break a fragile supplier — watch for signs of distress in the conversation and be ready to soften if supply continuity is at risk

Sayaji is our only proven cheaper source today; Tirupati, Gulshan and Sanstar are leads, not yet qualified — run CoA checks and small trial orders in parallel so we have a real fallback before we pull volume
If Universal won't match ₹66.48/KG, shifting the full ₹59.65 L spend to Sayaji concentrates risk on one supplier — keep at least two qualified lines active
The market asking price band is wide (₹60–81/kg); Universal may argue their higher end reflects tighter spec or service — pin them down on what justifies the ₹9/kg premium over Sayaji
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹75.51 a kilo for Dextrose when Sayaji gives us the same material at ₹66.48 — I need you to close that 13.6% gap or help me understand why we shouldn't move the volume.
